notes: Fixes: Delete now works for scheduled tasks, Explorer add-ons and startup shortcuts even when the program file is missing; Open file location brings Explorer to the front; Duplicates shows the SHA-256 fingerprint and re-verifies byte-for-byte before deleting. New navy look with a Scan button, Custom Clean with tick boxes and Deep Scan, full program uninstaller (silent or standard, with leftover removal), Large/Duplicate/Empty-folder finders, Windows Update cache cleanup, Windows 7 support and automatic update checks.
